body.p: At Isortuqdjuaq, in Kingawa, the beach is full of bowlders. One morning when Ohkoko went out of his house, he saw a whale stranded. He took his lance and tried to kill it. The whale made the bowlders and the mud fly, striking them with its tail. Then Ohkoko put stones on the tail in order to hold it down, but the whale just threw them about. The hunter kept close to its body in order to keep away from the flying bowlders. He finally killed the whale, and then went to the huts and told the people what he had done. When the tide rose, they took the whale close up to their huts, and cut it up. They were well provided for that winter.
